results.name: constant_effect_prognostic_I
results.expectation: True treatment effect is constant; moderation should be approximately zero despite strong prognostic I.

results.name: ceiling_measurement
results.expectation: Latent moderation is zero; bounded measurement should be able to manufacture negative observed moderation.

results.name: nonlinear_outcome_remeasurement
results.expectation: Same latent states can yield zero, negative, or positive additive moderation under nonlinear monotone outcome transformations.

results.name: positive_affine_outcome
results.expectation: Positive affine outcome remeasurement must preserve moderation sign and scale the linear coefficient by a.

results.name: baseline_structure_under_randomization
results.expectation: Strong shared baseline structure should not manufacture systematic moderation when treatment is genuinely randomized.

results.name: generic_plasticity
results.expectation: Primary responsiveness can be positive while discrimination is approximately zero.

results.name: discriminative_responsiveness
results.expectation: A discriminative world should separate warranted from misleading intervention responsiveness.
